rho_reference.protocol: IC row: ic.pipeline size=auto against matched rho.negation_v3 (A = 2, the strongest rho on these generic prime curves), same curves, targets and binary, interleaved
rho_reference.unit: ecbench.gae (counted group-addition equivalents), S = GAE / sqrt(r)

note: Local L0 container session; GAE is deterministic and replayed. 'ic' is the candidate arm, 'rho' the reference arm named in arms. Band values: run-weighted means of ecbench band mean_s.
